_comment: THE CONVERSATIONAL LOOP — PLAN 2x §3.3. The AI writes this file and bumps `rev`; the Texture panel polls /api/textureparams once a second and regenerates on a rev change. No websocket, no connection state, survives a page reload. `autoplay` is absent BY DESIGN — sound only ever on the composer's SPACE or Play. Every label must NAME THE DIALS IT MOVED (§6's two-sided contract), so the qualitative interface never goes opaque.
_slate: rev 5 (2026-08-20, day 21) - rev 2 UNTOUCHED (A-F = the smear tempo ladder the composer kept) + variant G appended: THE ACCRETION STEP-UP, the composer pairing spoken aloud - 4 players at C tempo, 6 at D, 8 at E, 10 at F - as ONE continuous 24 s gesture (6 s per step, gap 0; the engine default gap of 2 would insert silence). Players and tempo climb together, so composite rate goes 4.8 -> 9 -> 14.4 -> 22 per s, steeper than tempo alone. Free-form player browsing needs NO new variant: the panel players field regenerates on edit (resets to the file value on variant switch by design). rev numbering: 3 was the character x speed grid, 4 the six ladder-gestures; both in git. || rev 8 (2026-08-20, day 21): LIVE block for PLAN 2ag - the live rig (composer approved option a: gallop folded in via dBpm; auto-run included). Five sequences, each = jitterMs + dBpm + root + six (bpm,players) steps. The panel reads this block on every rev bump - AI writes land in the open panel within ~1 s, PROVEN LIVE this sitting (rev-7 probe: slot jump + bpm 61 observed in the boxes with no reload). Composer box edits are ephemeral until asked to be persisted here. S1-S3 = the kept A-F rungs in smear / rain (jit 45) / gallop (d2); S4 = extended accretion (players AND bpm climb, 4.8 -> 22/s); S5 = scratch. rev 6/7 were the uncommitted build + probe states. || rev 10 (2026-08-20, day 21): PHASE LADDER (composer-approved design, this sitting). New per-step number: offset (the rotor - player j at (j x offset) mod 1 of the per-player cycle; 0 = legacy even round-robin). Step count now follows the file (steps are rows in the panel grid). S6 phase = the first-pass 12-rung complexity ladder at fixed 108 BPM x 10: 0.1 even reference / 0.5 two pulse-stacks / 0.33333333 three / 0.25 four / 0.2 five pairs / 0.125 eight-grid accents / 0.0625 phrase+rest / 0.1875 sixteen-grid figure / 0.15 twenty-grid figure / 0.6180339887 golden lumpy / 0.03 wide cascade / 0.01 tightest decollage (mock-up-only precision - the ~30-50 ms stage/human floor applies live). Refine by asking - the AI rewrites the rungs, boxes follow within a second. Part 2 (the dialed 6-step stopwatch run) uses the same machinery once the composer names keepers. || rev 11 (2026-08-20, day 21): S6 phase = THE ZONE COMPLEXITY LADDER (composer chose the 1/2 -> 1/3 zone). The two-axis finding, composer-heard: offset AMOUNT and RATIO COMPLEXITY are independent; rev 10 walked amounts at mostly-simple ratios. This ladder holds the ZONE fixed and walks DEPTH via the mediant (Stern-Brocot) sequence: 1/2, 2/5, 3/7, 4/9, 5/12, 7/17, limit sqrt(2)-1 (the zone noble). Measured group counts 2/5/7/9/10/10/10 - pulse fissions into figure into lump; rungs 5-7 differ by GRID (12/17/never), an ear distinction not a count one. Fixed 108 BPM x 10, jitter 0. Other zones (around 1/3, 1/4) = future slates on request.
